_meta.note: 九幅：Vega 200 因 gate 的 edge>55 判为越界，已移出语料（图片留 artworks/_excluded/）

fields.why: why this painting is in the ten (2 sentences, specific, no mood words)
fields.notes: three 'look here' observations: a locatable feature + one thing to notice
fields.fault: where this translation fails — one sentence, with a measured number

01_georgia_o_keeffe_music_pink_and_blue_.why: O'Keeffe gave this series musical titles before she had any theory of what colour sounds like. It opens the collection because she asked the question first.

notes.label: The aperture
notes.text: The blue at the centre is the only patch that stays saturated; everything else retreats toward white. 34% of the canvas sits below S 0.15.

notes.label: The folds
notes.text: Pink to white is a continuous transition with no hard edge. The eye reads one moving surface, not a set of separate colours.

notes.label: The margin
notes.text: The paint stops short of the canvas on all four sides. That strip of bare canvas is part of the composition, not padding.

01_georgia_o_keeffe_music_pink_and_blue_.fault: The whole canvas becomes one average (L* 72.59 → B4, one loudness). But a third of it is nearly colourless and the rest is saturated pink — the average describes neither.

zh.why: O'Keeffe 给这一系列起的是音乐标题，那时她还没有任何关于「颜色听起来像什么」的理论。把这幅放在最前面，是因为她先提出了这个问题。

notes.label: The aperture
notes.text: 中间那块蓝是唯一保持饱和的区域，其余部分都在向白里退。全画 34% 的面积饱和度低于 0.15。

notes.label: The folds
notes.text: 粉到白的过渡是连续的，没有一条硬边，眼睛把它读成一个正在移动的面，而不是几种颜色。

notes.label: The margin
notes.text: 颜料在四边都停住，露出画布的白。那道白不是留白，是构图的一部分。

zh.fault: 全画被压成一个平均值（L* 72.59 → B4、一个响度）。但三分之一几乎无色、其余是高饱和的粉——这个平均值两边都不描述。

02_helen_frankenthaler_jacob_s_ladder.why: Her staining method puts colour inside the canvas instead of on top of it: no brush thickness, so no highlight to read. Lightness is the only reliable axis here — which is the one the mapping leans on.

notes.label: Stain, not paint
notes.text: Thinned oil soaked into unprimed canvas. The colour has no thickness, so there is no direction of a brush stroke to follow.

notes.label: Where it pooled
notes.text: Darkness comes from pigment collecting at the edge of the fabric. The lightness map is a record of drying, not of drawing.

notes.label: The white
notes.text: Bare canvas is the brightest thing in the image, and it takes the highest note.

02_helen_frankenthaler_jacob_s_ladder.fault: Saturation barely moves here (S 0.26, sd 0.12). R2 is supposed to turn purity into loudness, but on this canvas purity is almost constant — the volume never changes.

zh.why: 她的染色法把颜色放进画布里，而不是铺在表面上：没有笔触厚度，也就没有可以读的高光。明度在这里是最可靠的轴，而这正是映射依赖的那条。

notes.label: Stain, not paint
notes.text: 稀释的油渗进未上浆的画布，颜色没有厚度，所以画面上找不到一笔「扫过」的方向。

notes.label: Where it pooled
notes.text: 深浅来自颜料在布边积住的地方。这张明度图本质上是一张干燥记录，不是一张素描。

notes.label: The white
notes.text: 露出的画布是画面最亮的部分，它会在映射里拿到最高的音。

zh.fault: 这幅的饱和度几乎不变（S 0.26，标准差 0.12）。R2 本应把纯度变成响度，可这里的纯度是常数——整段音量不会动。

03_henri_matisse_la_desserte_rouge_the_d.why: The red was painted over an earlier blue version; the flatness is a decision, not a manner. It is the cleanest case of one colour occupying a huge area.

notes.label: One red
notes.text: Tablecloth and wall are the same red, separated only by the blue arabesque. There is no lightness difference between object and background.

notes.label: No shadow
notes.text: Matisse removed modelling. Depth comes from the curve of the vine, not from darkening.

notes.label: Measured
notes.text: 47% of the canvas falls within ±5 L* of the mean — nearly half the painting is a single note.

03_henri_matisse_la_desserte_rouge_the_d.fault: 47% of this painting sits within ±5 L* of the mean, so a red table and a red wall sound identical. Honest, and useless.

zh.why: 这块红是覆盖在蓝色版本上重画的，平整是一个决定，不是风格。它是「一个颜色、巨大面积」最干净的测试案例。

notes.label: One red
notes.text: 桌布和墙是同一块红，只靠那条蓝色藤蔓分开。这意味着画面里没有「物体」和「背景」的明度差。

notes.label: No shadow
notes.text: Matisse 去掉了塑形，深度来自藤蔓的弯曲，不是来自压暗。

notes.label: Measured
notes.text: 全画 47% 的像素落在平均明度 ±5 L* 之内——近一半画面是同一个音。

zh.fault: 47% 的画面集中在 ±5 L* 里，一张红桌子和一面红墙在这里听起来完全一样。这是诚实的，也是没用的。

04_mark_rothko_untitled_black_in_deep_or.why: Two fields, no gradient, and the boundary is the entire subject. It pushes the averaging approach to its limit: only 6% of the canvas is anywhere near its own mean lightness.

notes.label: Two weathers
notes.text: A black rectangle sits on warm orange. The edge is soft and feathered; it was never drawn.

notes.label: The edge
notes.text: Nothing happens inside either field. Everything happens where they meet.

notes.label: No average
notes.text: Measured: 6% of pixels fall within ±5 L* of the mean, the second lowest of the ten.

04_mark_rothko_untitled_black_in_deep_or.fault: Only 6% of the canvas is near its own average. For a painting made of two extremes, a mean-based mapping lands between them — where there is nothing.

zh.why: 两个色域，没有渐变，边界就是全部内容。它把「平均值」这个做法逼到极限：全画只有 6% 靠近平均明度。

notes.label: Two weathers
notes.text: 一块黑压在暖橙之上，交界是虚的、羽化的，从来没有被画成一条线。

notes.label: The edge
notes.text: 两块内部什么都没发生，所有事情都发生在它们相接的地方。

notes.label: No average
notes.text: 实测：只有 6% 的像素落在平均明度 ±5 L* 内，十幅里第二低。

zh.fault: 只有 6% 靠近平均值。对一个由两极构成的画面，均值映射只能落在中间——而中间什么也没有。

05_paul_gauguin_manao_tupapau_spirit_of_.why: Colour carries the narrative here: the yellow-green glow is the spirit, and it is the only unnatural colour in the painting. Colour does the work the title would otherwise do.

notes.label: The phosphorescence
notes.text: The yellow-green on the bed sheet is where the spirit sits. It is the only colour that does not belong to the available light.

notes.label: Wrong side
notes.text: The body is lit from the wrong side. The unease comes from that error, not from the expression.

notes.label: Flat blues
notes.text: The background blues are flat and decorative — closer to pattern than to space.

05_paul_gauguin_manao_tupapau_spirit_of_.fault: Mean lightness 33.85 → E3, half a semitone from Matisse's red table. This painting is frightening and that one is domestic; the sound is nearly the same.

zh.why: 颜色在这里承担了叙事：那道黄绿的光就是「幽灵」，是画面里唯一不自然的颜色。标题本来要靠文字做的事，被颜色做了。

notes.label: The phosphorescence
notes.text: 床单上的黄绿是幽灵所在。它是全画唯一不属于自然光的颜色。

notes.label: Wrong side
notes.text: 身体是从错误的一侧被照亮的，不安感来自这个错误，不是来自表情。

notes.label: Flat blues
notes.text: 背景的蓝是平涂的装饰，接近图案而不是空间。

zh.fault: 平均明度 33.85 → E3，与 Matisse 的红餐桌只差 0.5 个半音。这幅是恐惧，那幅是家常，声音几乎分不开。

06_paul_gauguin_tahitian_landscape.why: High-key, evenly lit, almost no tonal drama — the opposite case to Manao tupapau. It shows what the mapping does with a calm painting.

notes.label: Even light
notes.text: No strong shadow anywhere; L* sd 11.9, the lowest of the ten.

notes.label: Trees as pattern
notes.text: Foliage is drawn as repeated shapes rather than modelled volume.

notes.label: Temperature split
notes.text: Warm ground, cool sky. The division is by temperature, not by value.

06_paul_gauguin_tahitian_landscape.fault: 0.1 semitone and 6 Hz from Kandinsky's Yellow-Red-Blue. Two continents, thirty-four years apart, same note and same brightness.

zh.why: 高明度、均匀受光、几乎没有明暗戏剧——与《Manao tupapau》正好相反。用它看映射在一幅「平静」的画上会做什么。

notes.label: Even light
notes.text: 画面里没有强阴影，L* 标准差 11.9，十幅里最低。

notes.label: Trees as pattern
notes.text: 树冠被画成重复的形状，不做体积，接近纹样。

notes.label: Temperature split
notes.text: 暖的地、冷的天空——分区靠色温，不靠明度。

zh.fault: 与 Kandinsky《Yellow-Red-Blue》相差 0.1 个半音、6 Hz。两块大陆、相隔三十四年的画，落在同一个音、同一个亮度上。

08_wassily_kandinsky_impression_iii_conc.why: Painted after a Schoenberg concert: this is an attempt to render sound as colour. The premise of the mapping, run in reverse.

notes.label: The black mass
notes.text: The piano-shaped black at centre-left is the only object that survives the abstraction.

notes.label: Widest range
notes.text: L* sd 28.4, the largest of the ten: this canvas has the most extreme darks and lights.

notes.label: Yellow as brass
notes.text: Kandinsky assigned timbres to colours in his own writing; for him yellow was loud, brass.

08_wassily_kandinsky_impression_iii_conc.fault: The widest lightness range of the ten (sd 28.4) is compressed into a single anchor note. The painting that most wants to be heard gets the flattest translation.

zh.why: 画于一场勋伯格音乐会之后：这幅画是想把声音画成颜色。映射的前提，在这里被反着跑了一遍。

notes.label: The black mass
notes.text: 中偏左那块钢琴形状的黑，是抽象之后唯一还认得出的物体。

notes.label: Widest range
notes.text: L* 标准差 28.4，十幅里最大：这张画有最极端的黑和最极端的光。

notes.label: Yellow as brass
notes.text: Kandinsky 自己给颜色配过音色，黄色在他那里是响的、是铜管。

zh.fault: 十幅里明度跨度最大的一幅（标准差 28.4），被压成一个锚点音。最想被听见的画，得到了最平的翻译。

09_wassily_kandinsky_yellow_red_blue_gel.why: Three colour fields, three temperatures, one Bauhaus grid — the cleanest case for 'each colour should be its own voice'.

notes.label: Three fields
notes.text: Yellow upper left, red on the diagonal, blue circle lower right. Each is a different temperature and none gives way.

notes.label: Explicit geometry
notes.text: Unlike the 1911 painting, the geometry is stated here; nothing is dissolved.

notes.label: Measured collision
notes.text: E4 / 2362 Hz — 0.1 semitone from Tahitian Landscape.

09_wassily_kandinsky_yellow_red_blue_gel.fault: Yellow and blue are the two poles of this painting, and they map to almost the same pitch: one anchor, one loudness, one brightness. The opposition inside the painting disappears in the mix.

zh.why: 三块色域、三种温度、一个包豪斯式的几何框架——「每种颜色应该是一条独立声部」最干净的案例。

notes.label: Three fields
notes.text: 左上黄、对角红、右下蓝圆，各自是不同的温度，互不相让。

notes.label: Explicit geometry
notes.text: 与 1911 年那幅不同，这里几何是明写的，没有任何东西被溶解。

notes.label: Measured collision
notes.text: E4 / 2362 Hz，与《Tahitian Landscape》相差 0.1 个半音。

zh.fault: 黄和蓝是这幅画的两极，却映射到几乎同一个音高：一个锚点、一个响度、一个亮度。画里的对立在混音里消失了。

10_zao_wou_ki_20_03_60.why: The darkest of the ten (L* 30.14): calligraphic marks inside a nearly black field. It tests whether the mapping can handle near-darkness at all.

notes.label: Black is not empty
notes.text: The ground has structure, but it sits between L* 12 and 18, where most displays cannot resolve the layers.

notes.label: The red trace
notes.text: A single warm stroke crosses the upper third — the only saturated event in the painting.

notes.label: Calligraphy without characters
notes.text: The marks are movements of a brush, not signs.

10_zao_wou_ki_20_03_60.fault: L* 30.14 is the darkest of the ten, so the anchor falls to D3 and the whole piece is quiet. The red stroke — the one thing you are meant to see — is averaged into the black.

zh.why: 十幅里最暗的一幅（L* 30.14），近乎全黑的场里是书法性的笔痕。用它测试映射到底处理不处理得了「接近黑暗」。

notes.label: Black is not empty
notes.text: 底色里有结构，但落在 L* 12–18 之间，多数显示器在这个区间分辨不出层次。

notes.label: The red trace
notes.text: 一道暖色笔痕横过上三分之一，是全画唯一饱和的事件。

notes.label: Calligraphy without characters
notes.text: 那些笔痕是动作，不是字。

zh.fault: L* 30.14 是十幅里最暗的，锚点落在 D3，整首都很轻。那道红痕——唯一该被看见的东西——被平均进黑色里。
